With the aim of revealing the origin of the luminous CO emitting region, we observed the HzRG with the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA), obtaining CO(3–2) and continuum measurements.
As HzRGs are known for residing in overdense environment, we also search for additional companion galaxies.
